tools.name: rtk
tools.notes: Token-optimized command proxy. Router rewrites grep/find/cat through rtk; rtk rewrite exit-code protocol (0/1/2/3) is version-coupled (unchanged through 0.50.0). Since 0.49.0: -l is GNU --files-with-matches under rtk grep (completing 0.47.0's -t/-m passthrough), rewrite handles safe pipes, peels process wrapper prefixes, and passes sudo commands through. Since 0.50.0: head/tail rewrites are faithful to the native commands (head window no longer reads past the lines requested, non-UTF-8 windows preserved), git/grep/dotnet/golangci arg parsing migrated onto a shared arg_tokenizer, and rtk gain reports weighted savings rates with signed saved-token sums (negative totals are possible; the metrics.ts negative-delta/clawback branch already handles them). The new rtk ast-grep output filter is search-shaped like rtk grep and stays pass-through — it is not in the blocked cat/read/smart code-reading family.

tools.name: jcodemunch
tools.notes: Indexed code search MCP server. Powers scout agent, router fallback, and Step 2.5 divert; wheel-URL uvx installs are supported transports.

tools.name: graphify
tools.notes: Knowledge graph builder. PyPI package name is graphifyy; repo moved to Graphify-Labs (safishamsi redirects); version-warns outside tested range. 0.9.53 writes no .rebuild.lock; its shrink guard keeps a partial build from overwriting graph.json, and since 0.9.53 (#3203) an unverified per-source shrink arms the guard and re-queues the source on the next run — a first run can legitimately return a smaller graph that a later run completes. Since 0.9.65 (#3697/#3695) the eviction pass re-checks the kept set, so a moved-file/symlink layout can no longer deadlock the shrink guard into refusing every update. Since 0.9.66 graph.json is deterministic across runs (PYTHONHASHSEED pinned via a one-time re-exec; the re-exec exit-code races that path introduced were fixed through 0.9.67/0.9.68), and 0.9.68 preserves cross-file imports/calls/uses edges into unchanged files on incremental updates (node/edge counts shift upward on multilingual repos — a /savings display change, not a parse change). 0.9.70 ships security fixes — GHSA-pcc4-rvhr-2pr8 (the Fortran cpp step no longer reads arbitrary host files via absolute/traversing #include during preprocessing; contents could previously be inlined into graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md and the LLM context), --watch snippet shell injection closed, Terraform secret redaction widened — plus five new language extractors in 0.9.66 (COBOL, VB.NET, R, Solidity, Erlang). The GRAPH_REPORT.md summary/extraction layout that metrics.ts regex-matches is unchanged through 0.9.76 (nothing in 0.9.72-0.9.76 touches the summary or Extraction lines; 0.9.72's community-listing filter is a different section). Since 0.9.72 (five releases in one week through 0.9.76): additive extractor/resolution coverage plus one security fix — no CLI, graph.json layout, or MCP protocol change is announced. Rig-visible effects are numeric, the same class already recorded for 0.9.68: enum members became case_of nodes (0.9.73, Rust/Zig/C++/Scala 3) and intra-class self/this/super calls now bind across Python/JS/TS/Swift/Ruby (0.9.75), so node/edge counts shift upward; Rust prelude types no longer accumulate spurious in-degree, so god_nodes returns cleaner cores (a data-quality change to what rig's scout surfaces, not a parse change); cross-repo resolver confidence snapped to the canonical INFERRED rubric (0.9.76, label-only) shifts the EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS percentages session start reports. shortest_path (mcp__graphify__shortest_path, listed by rig's scout) resolves exact endpoints and refuses ambiguous ones (0.9.76), and routes through a contains edge back out to a symbol's file so cross-file paths through shared symbols are found instead of reporting none (0.9.75). 0.9.76 also stops walking JSON Schema files as config manifests, feeds only Svelte script blocks to the AST pass, and records calls edges to plainly-imported external Python modules (fail-closed). rig's only build trigger is graphify update (ensureGraphBuilt), so graphify extract's new dedup-shrink refusal has no rig path, and 0.9.72's auto-refresh touches only graphify's own installed skill sidecars, never rig's .claude/skills/. Security: graphify hook install refuses a core.hooksPath resolving outside the repository (CWE-22, graphify#3919) — no rig code path, rig never installs git hooks.

tools.name: headroom
tools.notes: Context-compression proxy. Repo moved to headroomlabs-ai (chopratejas redirects); detected via headroom-init-claude hook marker or localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; /savings reads `headroom perf --format json`. Since 0.38.0: zip-bomb DoS bound and per-port proxy logs. 0.39.0 reworked the savings surface (new-input basis beside whole-wire, exact cache-read cost in rollups, lifetime output spend, negative savings reported instead of floored at zero) and added protect_messages plus TPM limiting; captureHeadroomStats gates on finite numbers, so signed tokens_saved passes and renders. 0.39.1 fixes 0.39.0's TPM limiter refusing large-context requests — pin 0.39.1, never 0.39.0.

tools.name: superpowers
tools.notes: Base skills framework (required). Detected via ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json; every chain skill wraps a superpowers:* skill. 6.3.0 SDD task-batching (#2078) is deliberately declined in sdd+ (per-task dispatch is load-bearing); the Spec: pointer (#2086) is emitted by plan+; brainstorming ceremony scaling (#2063) does not scale down the brain+ overlay. 6.4.1's TDD full-suite-during-the-loop rule (#2110) is deliberately declined for the tdd+/sdd+ loop — the full-suite green gate stays in verify+ where the zero-defect hook blocks (divergence documented in the tdd+ template); its plan handoff (#2258/#2318) is answered Subagent-driven in sdd+, with tdd+ as rig's native/inline peer; plan+ emits the Review Focus section (#2319) and spec-reviewer verifies its pinning tests.
